name: Reel Me In
source:
You are a high school troublemaker who was caught committing a petty crime. During your winter break, you had two options: fish trash out of a polluted river for a week or pay a hefty fine. Being as broke as you are, fishing it is. Luckily, you’ve been paired with two cute guys! Not-so-luckily, something doesn’t seem quite right with this water… Well, it’s probably nothing. Let’s hope you can ‘catch’ a date with one of the boys by the end of the week before your community service is over!

[From [url=https://renbie.itch.io/reel-me-in]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名高中生，因犯轻微犯罪而被捕。在寒假期间，你有两个选择：从受污染的河流中捞出一周的垃圾，或者支付巨额罚款。像你一样穷，钓鱼就是。幸运的是，你和两个可爱的家伙配对了！不太幸运的是，这水似乎不太对劲……好吧，可能没什么。希望你能在社区服务结束前的周末与其中一个男孩“约会”！

[来自[url=https://renbie.itch.io/reel-me-in]itch.io[/url]]
